description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

ECPI University is an institution of higher education. The Associate Software Developer supports the design, development, testing, and maintenance of software applications and web-based systems, collaborating with senior developers and engineers to deliver scalable, reliable solutions for academic, enrollment, and student-success systems.
Software developer building, testing, debugging, and maintaining web applications and business systems

Responsibilities:
• Develop, test, debug, and maintain software applications and web solutions
• Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code following best practices
• Troubleshoot issues, identify root causes, and implement fixes in a timely manner
• Perform quality assurance testing for upgrades, patches, and new releases
• Assist in maintaining and improving existing systems and applications
• Stay current with emerging technologies, tools, and development methodologies
• Perform other duties as assigned

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent combination of education and practical experience)
• Foundational knowledge of programming concepts, data structures, and software design principles
• Experience with C# and web development technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
• Basic understanding of relational databases (e.g., Microsoft SQL Server)
• Experience using modern IDEs (e.g., Visual Studio, VS Code)
• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
• Effective written and verbal communication skills
• Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new technologies

Preferred:
• Experience working with APIs or web services
• Familiarity with Agile or Scrum methodologies
• Knowledge of UI/UX design principles
• Familiarity with AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) and responsible use practices, including prompt design, validation of generated code, and debugging assistance
• Understanding of version control systems (e.g., Git)
